items.title: Off-Policy Value-Based Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 面向大语言模型的离策略价值强化学习
items.summary: ReVal is a Bellman-update-based value RL framework for LLMs that combines stepwise internal-consistency signals with trajectory-level outcome verification, enabling replay-buffer training on past trajectories. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B it converges faster than GRPO and improves AIME24 by 2.7% and out-of-domain GPQA by 4.5%.

items.title: Sparse Autoencoders for Interpretable Medical Image Representation Learning
items.title_zh: 用于可解释医学图像表示学习的稀疏自编码器
items.summary: The study trains sparse autoencoders on BiomedParse and DINOv3 embeddings from 909,873 CT and MRI slices in the TotalSegmentator dataset. Ten learned features recover up to 87.8% of downstream performance with 99.4% dimensionality reduction, preserve retrieval semantics and support zero-shot language-driven image retrieval.

items.title: Show HN: Gemini can now natively embed video, so I built sub-second video search
items.title_zh: Show HN：Gemini 已能原生嵌入视频，我借此实现了亚秒级视频搜索
items.summary: The author built a CLI that uses Gemini Embedding 2 to project raw video into a 768-dimensional vector space alongside text, indexing hours of footage in ChromaDB for natural-language search with automatic clip trimming. Indexing costs about $2.50 per hour of footage, and still-frame detection skips idle chunks.

items.title: SpecEyes: Accelerating Agentic Multimodal LLMs via Speculative Perception and Planning
items.title_zh: SpecEyes：通过推测式感知与规划加速智能体式多模态 LLM
items.summary: SpecEyes is a speculative acceleration framework for agentic multimodal LLMs that uses a lightweight, tool-free model as a planner to predict execution trajectories and terminate expensive tool chains early. A cognitive gating mechanism based on answer separability regulates self-verification, and experiments on V* Bench, HR-Bench and POPE show 1.1-3.35x speedup while preserving or improving accuracy by up to 6.7%.

items.title: ReqFusion: A Multi-Provider Framework for Automated PEGS Analysis Across Software Domains
items.title_zh: ReqFusion：跨软件领域的多提供商 PEGS 自动化分析框架
items.summary: ReqFusion is a multi-provider framework that extracts and classifies software requirements from PDF, DOCX and PPTX documents using OpenAI, Anthropic and Groq models, guided by the PEGS structure. PEGS-guided prompting reached an F1 of 0.88 versus 0.71 for generic prompting, and evaluation on five projects with 1,050 requirements reported a 78% reduction in analysis time.

items.title: GTO Wizard Benchmark
items.title_zh: GTO Wizard Benchmark：无限注德州扑克智能体评测基准
items.summary: GTO Wizard Benchmark is a public API and standardized evaluation framework for heads-up no-limit Texas Hold'em that pits agents against the superhuman GTO Wizard AI and integrates AIVAT variance reduction. A zero-shot study of models including GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Grok 4 found clear progress but all models remain far below the benchmark baseline.

items.title: Helping developers build safer AI experiences for teens
items.title_zh: 帮助开发者打造更安全的青少年 AI 体验
items.summary: OpenAI released prompt-based teen safety policies for developers using gpt-oss-safeguard, intended to help moderate age-specific risks in AI systems.

items.title: From zero to a RAG system: successes and failures
items.title_zh: 从零搭建 RAG 系统：成功与失败
items.summary: A blog post recounts the successes and failures the author encountered while building a retrieval-augmented generation system from scratch.
